title: Leo's Language Helper
keywords: học từ vựng theo chủ đề
segments: Leo sat in his cozy bedroom after school. English class was tough today. He felt shy, often forgetting words when the teacher asked questions. Speaking in front of everyone made his heart race. He wanted to improve, but the usual methods weren't helping. Frustrated, Leo decided he needed a different way to learn English.

Because of this, Leo searched online for new ways to learn English. He found an AI chatbot called Lexi. Lexi suggested learning vocabulary by fun daily topics, like 'food' or 'travel'. This made his study time in his cozy bedroom much more enjoyable than usual. He felt excited to try this new method.

After that, Leo used Lexi every day. He learned new words about many daily topics. Weeks passed quickly. Leo noticed he remembered more English words. He even felt a little more comfortable using simple English phrases at home with his family. His mom smiled when he asked for "more juice, please" in English. Lexi was really helping him.

After that, Leo felt more confident. In English class, he understood many words the teacher used. One day, the teacher asked a simple question, and Leo answered it correctly! A small smile touched his face. But when the teacher asked for a longer answer, Leo still felt a little nervous. He wished he could speak more easily.

Because of this, Leo decided to use Lexi to practice speaking longer sentences. He told Lexi about his favorite hobby: building model airplanes. Lexi helped him learn specific words for parts and actions. Leo practiced his presentation many times. In English class, he stood up. He spoke clearly about his models, feeling proud and confident. His teacher smiled.

After his successful presentation, Leo felt truly confident. He no longer worried about speaking English in class. He answered questions, joined discussions, and even helped classmates with difficult words. Lexi had not only taught him words but also how to believe in himself. Leo smiled, ready for any English challenge.
endWrap: Leo's journey shows that practice and belief can help you achieve your goals. What new skill will you try to learn next?
